retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast studio portrait featuring a musician and instrument set against a glowing magenta and purple gradient with reflective foregrounds and projected light typography.
triggerTerms: reflective chrome instrument on purple surface
excludeWhen: minimalist black and white photography is requested
modern flat vector styles are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A surreal studio composition where a man in light-colored attire stands behind a highly reflective, liquid-like purple surface featuring a chrome trumpet. The background is a soft, hazy gradient of violet and magenta, punctuated by a glowing, projected script title that appears to be made of light.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject reflection mirrored in the foreground surface
Chrome instrument acting as a sharp focal point against soft background
Magenta color cast unifying the subject, instrument, and environment
Projected light text interacting with the atmospheric haze
coreInvariants: Dominant magenta and violet color palette

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Musician positioned mid-ground left, medium shot; instrument positioned foreground right, large scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The chrome trumpet in the lower right quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the sharp detail of the trumpet, across the reflective surface to the musician, then up to the glowing title.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant atmospheric space in the upper right and center to allow for light projections.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White and Silver (Subject clothing and Chrome instrument)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the mid-tones with bright, glowing highlights and deep purple shadows.

letterConstructionRules: Top text: Wide, blocky sans-serif with internal gradients
Secondary text: Fluid, slanted script mimicking a light projection or neon tube
characterSpecificRedesigns: Script letters feature soft, blurred edges to simulate light diffusion
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between rigid, geometric header and fluid, organic light-script.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, blocky 80s aesthetic of the top text
Captures the casual, slanted script energy for the projection

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a man in a white shirt and vest standing behind a highly reflective purple metallic table. Place a chrome trumpet on the table in the foreground. The background should be a hazy magenta and violet gradient with a soft light spot in the center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add wide sans-serif text at the top with a purple-to-pink gradient fill. Add a large, glowing white script title on the right side, tilted diagonally and blurred to look like a light projection.

verificationChecks: Does the script text have a soft glow?
Is the color palette dominated by magenta and violet?
Is the trumpet rendered in high-shine chrome?

mustRedesign: Any literal artist names or specific album titles
Exact facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Seamless integration of subject and reflection
Convincing volumetric light effect for the script
High-fidelity metallic texture on the instrument

postGenerationChecks: Check that the reflection matches the subject's pose
Ensure the script text looks like light, not a sticker
Verify the chrome highlights are bright white
Confirm the overall 1980s studio aesthetic is maintained
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a sharp metallic object in the foreground with a soft-focus subject in the mid-ground, unified by a monochromatic neon color cast and light-based typography.
